text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: high GPU queue growth in aws eu-north-1 — autoscaler failing to provision, several retries hitting quota errors. Severity: potential customer impact.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0457. Join thread for coordination. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0457

sara: I’m on it. Seeing a big spike in pending requests in the inference queue (rbq-infer-prod-eu).

sara: Metrics: queue depth up from ~200 to 18k over 8m. Pod count stuck at 0->16, then flapping.
mike: Any autoscaler errors in logs?

sara: Yes — autoscaler logs show AWS API quota errors on CreateFleet/RunInstances.
sara: Example from controller: `ClientError: You have requested more instances than your current vCPU limit allows for the specified instance type.`
jia: That looks like a quota/vCPU limit, not a GPU-specific error string but our GPU instance family maps to vCPU quotas on this account.

andrew: I'm seeing `Throttling: Rate exceeded` from EC2 DescribeInstanceTypes as well. Possibly a combination of account quota + API throttle.

ops-jen: Are there any planned capacity reservations or reserved instances that might be consuming limits?
sara: No scheduled reservations in billing console for eu-north-1. Customer usage spikes + another team's smoke tests earlier likely pushed us over.

mike: Impact: are incoming requests being rejected or queued?
sara: Ingress is still accepting but tokens are queuing; we’ve started 429s for low-priority routes when queue > 10k. Some high-priority customers see latency > 30s.

carla: Noted — I'm on customer comms. Which customers are affected?
sara: Top affected: acme-payments (critical), jotly, several PLG trial orgs. Carla — will DM the list and SLA exposure.

kevin: Quick mitigation attempts? Scale to another region?
jia: We can try cross-region failover to eu-west-1 where capacity looks healthy. But model variants and KV cache cold-start will increase latency/errors.
andrew: Also option: enable CPU fallback (quantized CPU path) for low-priority requests — much slower but keeps app-level success rates.

sara: I propose three parallel mitigations: 1) throttle non-critical routes at the ingress (reduce burst), 2) enable CPU fallbacks for trials/low-tier, 3) failover new requests to eu-west-1 as emergency.

mike: Agree. Assign actions. Sara — throttle inbound and modify routing. Jia — prepare failover stack + ops checks. Andrew — script CPU-fallback toggle. Carla — customer comms. Ops-jen — engage cloud billing/account to confirm quota increase request ETA.

sara: Starting with ingress rules. Patch envoy route to add rate-limit for `route: /generate` where org_tier != enterprise.
sara: Pushing config: ```bash
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: EnvoyFilter
metadata:
  name: rate-limit-temp
spec:
  # minimal patch
EOF
```

sara: Rate-limit applied. Non-critical traffic cut by ~70% per dashboard. Queue growth slowed but still climbing because existing backlog draining slowly.
jia: Preparing eu-west-1 failover. Creating dedicated fleet with smaller instance types to bypass vCPU limit. Creating AMI with cached model snapshot.
jia: Commands going out: ```bash
# create temporary fleet
aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-0caf... --count 10 --instance-type g4dn.xlarge --region eu-west-1
```
andrew: CPU fallback toggle ready: `sh ./toggle_cpu_fallback.sh enable --groups=trials,free-tier` — toggling now.
andrew: CPU fallback enabled. Error rate for trials dropped, success rate up to 94% (but p95 latency ~6-8s).

carla: I posted a short initial customer note to affected customers and set expectations for mitigation window (~30-60m). Link: https://app.intercom/messages/abc123

ops-jen: I filed a quota increase case with AWS support, reference 123456789 — initial response ETA 2-6 hours. Not helpful for immediate restore.
mike: Any sign of autoscaler recovering?
sara: Autoscaler still logging quota error  `UnauthorizedOperation` and `VcpuLimitExceeded`. Stack: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/scale/autoscaler?orgId=1&panel=logs

oncall-bot: Reminder: next rotation in 28m. Handoff planned.

kevin: Jia, have you validated the model artifact in eu-west-1 AMI? Cold-start can cause memory OOMs if wrong quantization.
jia: Validated on a small instance, model boots and returns expected tokens. Will run gradual rollout with canary 2 instances then scale to 10.
jia: Canary started — 2 instances healthy. Adding another 8.

mike: Update customers on expected degraded latency for failover requests. Carla please update comms.

carla: Updated message: "We've redirected some traffic to a backup region to restore capacity; you may see increased latency but service should be available. We're working on restoring normal capacity in eu-north-1." Sent to affected accounts.

andrew: After enabling cpu fallback + ingress throttle + eu-west failover, queue depth trending down from 18k -> 2.3k in 18m. Token consumption back to normal.
sara: Good. I'm going to keep autoscaler and cloud error logs streaming for another 20m. We need to prepare a postmortem: root cause likely account vCPU quota exhaustion combined with API throttling.

mike: Assign postmortem owners: Sara (ops timeline), Jia (failover playbook), Andrew (fallback policy), Ops-jen (quota request and contact with cloud acct team), Carla (customer impact timeline).

oncall-bot: Handoff: Mike -> Kevin for next on-call. Kevin will take over after 14:05 UTC.

kevin: Taking over. Monitoring dashboards and logs. Any outstanding work?
sara: Two items: 1) complete cleanup: remove temporary rate-limit after backlog drained, 2) confirm failover traffic drains and we can tear down eu-west temporary fleet.

jia: Tear down plan in 40m after 1h of stable queues <500. Will snapshot logs and AMI.

mike: Quick note for postmortem: include timeline of other tenants' smoke tests that started ~08:12 UTC, correlate with API spikes.

ops-jen: I've linked billing & cloud account owners in the incident doc and requested expedited quota review. Also opened internal ticket to review reservation strategy for critical regions.

carla: Preparing customer follow-up with timeline + mitigation steps once we have final metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy to prod: envoy-rate-limit rollback scheduled in 45m by sara. Change ID: change-8981.

kevin: I'll monitor for 60m then rotate. If anything changes ping me in this thread.

sara: Queue stabilized at 180 by last sample. Rolling back temp rate-limit in 10m.

mike: Great work team. Postmortem draft expected EOD. Closing active incident when fleets torn down and metrics stable.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0457 status -> Mitigated. Severity downgraded to S3; follow-up required for quota & reservations.

sara: Marking tasks for post-incident: quota escalation details, cross-team coord, capacity reservations plan, automated failover runbook improvements.

kevin: Thanks all.
